_comment_1: TutorCraft AI — Pronunciation & Web Speech API Configuration (content/speech_rules.json). Derived from TECHNICAL_BLUEPRINT.md Section 3 (3.2-3.5). Tunable without code changes; evaluated by src/engine/pronunciation.ts on both client (provisional) and server (authoritative).

featureFlags._comment_2: Privacy & inclusion rules (Section 3.2): Voice mode is strictly optional and off by default for child safety (5+ years old, cloud audio streaming in Chrome/Edge). Every voice task has a typed/tapped equivalent earning identical game progress.

normalisation._comment_3: Text preprocessing applied to both target strings and SpeechRecognition transcript alternatives before computing token/phoneme Levenshtein distances (Section 3.4).

scoringWeights._comment_4: WER/PER and confidence weightings (Section 3.4). Multi-word/sentence targets use 0.55 wordScore + 0.30 phonemeScore + 0.15 confScore. Single-word targets shift weight to phonemeScore (0.40) and wordScore (0.45) because a one-word token match is otherwise binary. When SpeechRecognition returns confidence <= 0 (unavailable), the 0.15 confidence weight is reallocated to wordScore.

levelRules._comment_5: Pass thresholds (0-100 scale), listening windows, and TTS playback rates across the 6 teaching levels (0 = Beginner with full Vietnamese support for ages 5+ through 5 = CEFR C1). Beginner receives an extended 12s listening window (vs 8s for levels 1-5) and a slower 0.7x TTS modeling rate (vs 0.85x) to accommodate young Vietnamese learners.

passThresholdsByLevel._comment_6: Flat lookup map of minimum passing pronunciation score (%) keyed by teaching level (0-5); applies equally to single words and full sentences.

starThresholds._comment_7: Star reward tiers (Section 3.4): passing at or above the level's passThreshold earns 1 star; >= 85 earns 2 stars; >= 95 earns 3 stars.

attemptsAndHints._comment_8: Non-punitive retry policy (Section 3.4): up to 3 attempts per target, best score counts, zero coin or star penalty on failure. After the 2nd miss, the companion Pet enters 'coach' state to show a free tier-1 mouth-shape/phoneme hint, and the 3rd attempt unlocks after a TTS replay.

timingConstraints._comment_9: Speech duration and silence detection windows (Section 3.4): standard listening window is 8.0s (8000ms) for levels 1-5 and 12.0s (12000ms) for Beginner (level 0). Recognition stops automatically after 1.8s (1800ms) of trailing silence after speech begins. Utterances shorter than 0.4s (400ms) total speech are rejected as 'too_short' to filter out accidental mic clicks or noise.

speechRecognitionConfig._comment_10: Browser Web Speech API parameters and iOS Safari gesture constraints (Section 3.3).

ttsConfig._comment_11: speechSynthesis modeling parameters (Section 3.3): cancel queued utterances before speaking and re-check getVoices() on voiceschanged.

fallbacks._comment_12: Graceful degradation when SpeechRecognition is unsupported (e.g., Firefox), mic permission is denied, network/audio-capture fails, or voice is disabled by the teacher (Sections 3.3 & 3.4).

abuseAndRateLimits._comment_13: Server-side anti-cheat and rate-limiting rules enforced via rate_limits and speech_attempts tables (Section 3.4).

interactionAndGameHooks._comment_14: 3D Phonetic Stones & Pet interaction budgets and per-game reward hooks (Section 3.5).
